title: Senior Full Stack (Python/React )Engineer
description:
About Digis
Digis is a European IT company with 250+ specialists delivering complex products for 70+ clients across the U.S., Europe, and Canada. We focus on long-term collaboration, stable projects, and transparent processes.

About the Project

The position is open for an on-site setup in Warsaw, Poland with regular office attendance required.
You will join an AI-powered media/e-commerce project focused on creating digital media and video content around products and different niches.
The product enables users to create content using AI-generated avatars and influencers that can produce media on the user's behalf. The project is currently actively scaling.
The Full Stack Developer will work on building and improving the platform, developing end-to-end features, scalable backend services, and cloud-based solutions while contributing to the product’s technical growth.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in web development
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and React
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services
  • Advanced proficiency in using AI tools as part of the software development process
  • Upper-Intermediate English level or higher


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain full-stack applications using Python and React
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services
  • Develop and deploy cloud-based solutions on AWS
  • Take ownership of features from development through production
  • Use AI tools as part of the development process to improve engineering efficiency
  • Collaborate closely with the team to deliver high-quality product features
  • Contribute to technical decisions and continuous improvements of the platform


Advantages

  • Work on an AI-powered media/e-commerce product at an active scaling stage
  • Build features around AI-generated avatars, influencers, and digital content creation
  • Take significant ownership over technical decisions and end-to-end feature delivery
  • Work in a fast-paced startup environment where engineering decisions have a direct impact on the product
  • Use modern technologies including Python, React, AWS, and AI development tools
  • Contribute to building scalable solutions from early product stages
  • Collaborate closely with experienced team and have direct impact on product evolution
  • Work on a product combining software engineering, AI technologies, and modern media solutions


We Offer

  • 20 paid vacation days per year
  • 5 paid sick days
  • Compensation for professional courses
  • English learning support
  • Work equipment
  • Transparent communication and processes
  • Accounting support
  • Corporate psychologist
